name: docker-leviosa
description: Docker volume observability: size, contents, container dependencies and safe cleanup guidance.

scripts.//workspaces: Package membership lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml, not here: pnpm ignores the `workspaces` field, and keeping both invites the two from drifting apart.
scripts.//dev: Contracts are compiled once before anything imports them, then all three packages watch in parallel so a change to a shared type reaches both apps without a restart.
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --parallel run dev
scripts.//build: `-r` walks the workspace in dependency order, so shared is built before the two packages that import it. No manual sequencing needed.
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run typecheck
